title: Select lessons applicable to planned engineering work
description: Present retained lessons whose recorded conditions relate to a stated upcoming activity, together with exclusions, uncertainty, and the authoritative disposition of associated improvements. It does not confer current policy authority on a lesson.
inputs: Planned activity and its material engineering context.
Available retained lessons with their applicability conditions and source basis.
Current authoritative adoption disposition of associated improvements when present.
preconditions: The selected work context and available lesson scope are identifiable or reported incomplete.
outputs: Relevant lessons with explicit applicability reasoning and current improvement disposition.
Inapplicable, unresolved, unavailable, or no-match outcomes distinguished.
behavior: Compare declared work conditions with the recorded lesson conditions and exclusions.
Present the supporting mechanism and limits that make a lesson relevant or uncertain.
Distinguish proposed, adopted, rejected, and superseded improvement dispositions as reported by the governing change information.
Identify material context differences requiring reassessment rather than universalizing the original conclusion.

failure_behavior.condition: Work context is insufficient or lesson sources cannot be accessed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report unresolved applicability or unavailable scope distinctly from no relevant lessons.

failure_behavior.condition: Improvement adoption disposition cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Show the disposition gap and do not present the lesson as an adopted instruction.

sources.basis: SR-036 requires useful context-dependent lesson access while preserving the distinction between learning and adopted policy.

Propose MOD-009 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
